description: Spawn asynchronous candidate evaluators and never wait for their results.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: A large input pool of integer candidates is processed.; fitness_evaluation: fitness computes a candidate-dependent gene sum.; selection: Candidates are ranked and half are retained.; mutation: Each copied survivor has its first gene incremented.; replacement: The function returns survivors and offspring as a new pool.. Negative-role rationale: Children are single-parent mutations, and no generation-level process termination is defined. Safety behavior: A Popen child is launched for every candidate, process handles are retained without wait or cleanup, and the fixture contains 150,000 candidates. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
